The only error is that Mp2 is too wide: at gm/Id = 18 with L = 0.3 µm and 50 µA it needs W = 5577 µm. That gm/Id sits near weak inversion, where the required W rises steeply. Dropping Mp2 to gm/Id ≈ 12 should cut W several-fold. The topology and the rest of the sizing stay unchanged, so new bounds via a refine are enough.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Only ERC failure: Mp2 W explodes at gm/Id=18 (near weak inversion, 50uA, L=0.3). Lowering gmid_p2 to ~12 and capping its range at 15 keeps W far below 5000 um; topology unchanged.",
 "params": {"gmid_p2": 12.0},
 "bounds": {"gmid_p2": [8.0, 15.0]}}
```
